prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and proper meal timing around a 90-minute morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre/post-workout nutrition
Total daily carbohydrates are 8-10g per kg of body weight (544-680g)
Pre-run meal provided 1-2 hours before the 90-minute session; post-run meal within 30-60 minutes
Plan is presented in a compact, single-day format with clear timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Strength and muscle gain for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals for one day with specific food items
Protein intake meets or exceeds 1.6-2.2g per kg bodyweight (136-187g total)
Macronutrient composition includes carbohydrates for training energy and fats for hormone production
Meals are practical and achievable for a single athlete without excessive complexity
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with elevated protein requirements and macro-focused meal composition

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3 meals covering breakfast, lunch, and dinner
All foods comply with vegan, gluten-free, and tree nut-free restrictions
Includes sufficient protein sources (legumes, seeds, plant-based alternatives) for muscle maintenance
Plan is compact and concise (under 200 words)
